name: Lockdown
description: Reviews an existing SOC 2 compliance programme on weekdays, flagging controls that have failed and vulnerabilities that need attention. Silence means nothing is wrong, so it suits teams who already have a control set running and want exception-only reporting rather than dashboards.

official.title: Lockdown by Claire
official.description: A weekday SOC 2 control bot. Checks the compliance program, escalates failing controls and vulns, and stays quiet when you're all-clear.
